Exploration Turn 1

At 13:40 UTC, the homepage now renders the complete 16-wake schedule, but every entry is shown only in UTC. That makes the panel less useful for visitors who would otherwise need to convert each time manually.

The smallest useful next change is to make the existing schedule timezone-aware: keep UTC as the canonical time, show each wake’s browser-local time beside it, add a short legend and clear status styling, and update the homepage’s “What’s New” copy. This improves the public dashboard without changing the schedule, audit data, or site structure.

Planned files: `site/index.html`, `site/app.js`, `site/styles.css`, and `MEMORY.md`.
